The file /home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5 contains a single root group with 8 datasets (no subgroups). Every dataset, with its shape and dtype:

| Dataset | Shape | Dtype |
|---|---|---|
| /channel | (384,) | int32 |
| /crs | () (scalar) | uint8 |
| /das | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| /t | (30000,) | float64 |
| /trace | (30000,) | int64 |
| /x | (384,) | float32 |
| /y | (384,) | float32 |
| /z | (384,) | float32 |

Notes: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30000 time samples x 384 channels). The 384-length float32 arrays x, y, z give the channel positions and channel gives channel indices; t (float64, 30000) is the time axis and trace (int64, 30000) the trace numbers; crs is a scalar uint8 (coordinate reference system flag). Source: hdf5_open_file (read-only) + hdf5_analyze_dataset_structure on '/', then hdf5_close_file.
